id: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (2003)

vibe.verdict: A proper gilt banquet with the right beats (beacons, Shelob, Denethor, the Green Dragon), but the writing stays polite and misses the best hobbit food jokes.
missing: Merry and Pippin smoking and eating salted pork on the Isengard wall (opening)
Sam: 'I can't carry it for you, but I can carry you' (Mount Doom)
Gollum framing Sam over the lembas
Eowyn's 'I am no man' at the Pelennor Fields
Strawberries and cream speech at Mount Doom
ideas: Swap 'Pale root beer over honey ginger syrup' note for a Green Dragon line: 'A mug of ale, feet up on a settle, after a hard day's work.'
Swap toast II 'Shelob's lair at Cirith Ungol' for 'Salted pork on the Isengard wall', so the toasts are about eating.
Rename 'Steward's roast drumsticks and grapes' to 'Denethor's tomatoes and drumsticks' and use the Pippin song note.
Add a 'Sam's strawberries and cream' tag line to the Shire strawberries note.
